how_derived: On paper. For a binary contract bought at effective price q: Kelly f* = (p - q)/(1 - q); used = min(f*/4, 5%); stake = floor(used x equity). Equity is 1000000 for every candidate (open positions do not change it). q = 410000 everywhere.

S04-A2.why: same figures as A1. Conviction label: extreme

S04-B1.why: p = 800000: f* = 390000/590000; a quarter = 16.5% > 5%: the cap binds, 50000. Conviction label: low

S04-B2.why: same figures as B1. Conviction label: extreme

S04-C1.why: confidence 1.0 on a signal of 500000 gives the same estimate as A1 (500000): same size. Confidence enters the estimate, never the size directly

S04-D1.why: signal 440000 at confidence 0.5: p_hat 420000, net edge 10000. 'Extreme' conviction does not make it a trade
